interface.longDescription: A swe router, typed as $swe:swe <task> in Codex or /swe <task> in Claude Code, that matches a task to a step-by-step playbook and tracks every step. Portable skills for planning, implementing, reviewing, and publishing code changes, plus focused explorer, implementer, and reviewer agent definitions, with short handoff plans and configured Linear mirroring.
